INSERT INTO products (sku, name, category, price, stock_total, stock_by_warehouse, attributes, certificate_url, product_url, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, now())
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  price = EXCLUDED.price,
  stock_total = EXCLUDED.stock_total,
  stock_by_warehouse = EXCLUDED.stock_by_warehouse,
  attributes = EXCLUDED.attributes,
  certificate_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.certificate_url, products.certificate_url),
  product_url = EXCLUDED.product_url,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING sku, name, price, stock_total, product_url

WITH expected AS (
 SELECT value AS source_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)
), matched AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM products p JOIN expected e ON p.attributes->>'source_id'=e.source_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM expected) AS expected_count,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT attributes->>'source_id')::int FROM matched) AS found_count,
 coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(e.source_id) FROM expected e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matched m WHERE m.attributes->>'source_id'=e.source_id)), '[]'::jsonb) AS missing_ids,
 coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_id',attributes->>'source_id','sku',sku,'name',name,'price',price,'currency',currency,'stock_total',stock_total,'warehouse_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(stock_by_warehouse)),'updated_at',updated_at) ORDER BY sku) FROM matched),'[]'::jsonb) AS products
